tasks.description: Add an 'Export to CSV' button on the sales report page. This button should initiate a download of the currently displayed report. The button should be accessible and follow the product's design guidelines.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the user clicks the 'Export to CSV' button, then a download of the report is initiated.

tasks.description: Develop a backend endpoint that generates the CSV for the requested report and streams the response to the client. This endpoint should handle large reports efficiently without buffering the entire file in memory.
acceptance_criteria: Given a large sales report, when the export endpoint is called, then the response is streamed to the client without exceeding memory limits.

tasks.description: Implement a feature that allows users to choose which columns to include in the export before downloading. The generated CSV should include only the selected columns, in the displayed order.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the user selects specific columns, then the generated CSV includes only the selected columns in the correct order.

tasks.description: Encode the CSV per RFC 4180: quote fields containing commas, double quotes, or newlines, and escape embedded double quotes by doubling them. This ensures the CSV is standards-compliant and opens cleanly in common spreadsheet applications.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sales report with special characters, when the CSV is generated, then the fields are properly escaped according to RFC 4180.

tasks.description: Ensure the first row of the CSV contains the human-readable column names for the selected columns. This improves the usability of the exported CSV.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sales report with selected columns, when the CSV is generated, then the first row includes the human-readable column names.

tasks.description: Connect the 'Export to CSV' button with the streaming export endpoint. When the button is clicked, it should call the endpoint with the correct parameters to initiate the download.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the user clicks the 'Export to CSV' button, then the streaming export endpoint is called with the correct parameters.
